title: ColoFixes
description: A small colleciton of client side fixes for Pixelmon, intended for the Colomon Modpack
body:
## ColoFixes is Client Side
This mod aims to fix a few issues and is intended for the Colomon Modpack, but can be used by anyone.

## Fixes
### Pixelmon
- Turn Timer - Fixes extremely fast countdown
- Switch Out Task Timeout - Fixes one of the waiting issues when an opponent switches in battle
- Fixes scrolling horizontally on Research Reward sections when a Research had more than 2 objectives and more than 3 rewards
- Fixes scrolling in the Research, Daycare, and Pokedex tabs leaking through to the inventory layer causing items items to be shuffled
- Fixes the orientation of 3D models in Pixelmon's notice overlays

Requires Pixelmon 9.3.16
